WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Rolling User Researcher (Rolling UXR) to deliver fast, high-signal insights that improve Notion’s product experiences across Product, Design, and Engineering (EPD)—including AI-powered workflows like Notion custom agents and chat. This is a tactical, high-velocity role: you’ll run lightweight usability and concept tests on a steady cadence, identify what’s not working, and help teams translate feedback into concrete product changes. Besides conducting research, you’ll also build and scale a program that makes it easy for product teams to submit testing requests and easy for you to recruit participants, along with a prioritization framework that helps you focus on the most important work.



This role is ideal for a researcher who loves the craft of moderated testing, can context-switch across many teams, and thrives in a “many small studies” model.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - End-to-end tactical research: Scope, design, and execute quick-turn research across the product lifecycle—delivering clear recommendations that drive product decisions, including
   
   - Rolling usability testing: Plan and moderate rapid usability tests on prototypes and in-product flows; identify friction, comprehension gaps, and failure points; recommend practical fixes and prototype them with AI.
   
   - Concept testing: Help teams evaluate early ideas (storyboards, low/high-fidelity prototypes, new IA) to understand desirability, comprehension, and expected workflows—before teams invest heavily in build.

 - Research pipeline ownership: Keep an always-on motion healthy by managing intake/prioritization, study cadence, participant recruitment, and consistent output formats so partners know what to expect and can act quickly.

 - Communication: Deliver crisp, actionable recommendation (severity, confidence, recommended next steps) in the right format for the audience—async write-ups, clips, or working sessions.

 - Business-minded impact: Connect findings to outcomes—why an issue matters, what to change, and what to watch—then follow through with teams to ensure improvements land.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Research craft: You can independently run usability and/or concept tests end-to-end (scoping → protocol → moderation → synthesis → readout), and you know how to keep scope tight while preserving rigor. You’re also comfortable using AI thoughtfully to speed up prep/synthesis while maintaining quality and traceability to evidence.

 - AI fluency: You’re curious and hands-on with AI products and can translate concepts, like trust, usefulness, tone, safety, and clarity, into observable behaviors and research questions.

 - Pragmatism + speed: You excel at prioritizing in fast-moving environments, are comfortable with ambiguity, and can deliver quality research quickly with transparent limitations.

 - Systems thinking: You can quickly understand complex user journeys and identify where experiences break down across the system—from inputs, to product behavior, to UI patterns.

 - Communication: You write clearly, facilitate effectively, and can translate messy data into decisions and next steps for busy EPD partners.

 - Collaboration: You’re comfortable working across many stakeholders and switching context quickly without dropping details.

 - Experience: 3+ years of hands-on UX research experience (industry, agency, or equivalent)




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with AI-enabled product experiences (e.g., assistants/agents) and how to evaluate workflow success, user expectations, and trust.

 - Comfort collaborating on research-operations basics (recruiting, scheduling, etc.) to keep a rolling cadence healthy.

 - Background in UX design, engineering, or similar.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $164,000-$190,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. About Atomic
 Atomic is a venture studio and venture capital firm that builds and scales companies from the ground up. We partner with exceptional founders to launch transformative businesses across industries including AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer, enterprise software, and more. We've launched and scaled more than 20 companies including Hims & Hers, Exowatt, Replicant, Found, Golden Child, and Homebound.

 Position Overview
 We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly alongside our founder and Managing Partner, and give him meaningful leverage across everything he touches. The firm moves fast across a large and varied portfolio; this person makes sure the most important things move forward, that nothing critical falls through the cracks, and that the CEO’s time and attention go where they matter most.
 This role is both highly strategic and deeply hands-on. You'll operate as a thought partner and a doer - translating priorities into action, owning follow-through from start to finish, managing the flow of information and communication, and serving as a trusted bridge across the firm, its companies, and outside partners.
 This is also an AI-native role by design, and we expect it to evolve continuously. The best person in this seat instinctively uses AI to take work off their own plate - automating the routine so they can keep moving up to higher-leverage work. The job you start with shouldn't be the job you're doing a year from now.
 The best version of this person becomes genuinely indispensable, earns more responsibility over time, and builds a deep, lasting partnership with the firm and our portfolio.

 Responsibilities
 • Be a key point of leverage for the Founder and Managing Partner across the full range of his work, internal and external - taking things off his plate and extending his reach.

• Identify the few things that matter most and drive them home - taking the firm's most important projects and initiatives to timely, high-quality completion, and owning the outcome rather than just the to-do list.

• Be the forcing function for decisions and action. Surface what needs deciding, put a clear question in front of whoever owns it, and press until it's resolved.

• Own follow-through end to end: capture what needs to happen, run it down across whoever needs to move, and close the loop without being asked or reminded.

• Represent the CEO with internal and external stakeholders - in meetings, on email, and on calls - making sure he walks into everything prepared and walks out with the follow-ups handled.

• Manage the flow of information and communication around the CEO and the firm's executives, synthesizing the firehose into what people need to know and decide.

• Sit in board meetings and stand in for the CEO at portfolio companies he's most involved in to keep the highest priority projects moving forward

• Partner closely with Atomic's executives to keep the whole leadership group aligned and moving in the same direction.

• Be the trusted liaison across the team, the portfolio, and outside partners, and handle the most sensitive, confidential matters with complete discretion.

 Who You Are
 • An exceptional communicator . You write and speak with clarity, concision, and judgment - able to represent the firm to anyone, distill the complicated down to what actually matters.

• Highly organized . You bring structure to an inherently unstructured job - imposing order on the swirl of priorities, communications, and action items so nothing slips and the people around you can move faster.

• Action-oriented . You have a sharp instinct for the few things that matter most at any given moment, and you clear the decks to make them happen and drive them to done.

• Genuinely curious and humble . You ask good questions, listen more than you talk, want to understand before you act, and you're simply a good person to be around.

• Low ego, no drama. You care about the outcome, not the credit. You'll go deep on the work that needs to get done and do whatever the moment calls for without worrying about whether it's technically "your job." No politics, no theatrics, just a steady and straightforward presence people trust.

• High trust and range. We can hand you the most sensitive, consequential things and not think about them again - discreet, reliable, and steady when the stakes and pressure are high. And you move fluidly between a board-level conversation, a go-to-market problem, and an operational fire in the same day, with the instincts of a builder.

• AI-native . You already use modern tools to do the work of a team, and you're relentless about turning them on your own work - automating the routine and continually raising what you're capable of.

 Qualifications
 • A track record of operating at high velocity and high trust near the center of an ambitious organization - as a chief of staff, operator, founder, or in consulting, banking, or investing. We care far more about range, judgment, and drive than about any single pedigree.

• Time as an early or senior contributor at a fast-moving startup or high-growth company, with evidence you drove outcomes.

• Exceptional organization and execution, with the ability to keep a dozen plates spinning and never drop the one that matters.

• Scrappy and resourceful. You build structure where there is none and stay calm when the ground is shifting.

• Genuinely excited to commit to this role and grow alongside the firm.

 We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.
